Container.Name: hotspot-dashboard
Container.Overview: Live status dashboard for a fleet of Pi-Star / WPSD ham radio hotspots, polled over SSH every few seconds for uptime, temperature, signal, and active-call info.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard web interface

Config.Name: WSJT-X UDP Port
Config.Description: Only needed for the optional live WSJT-X QSO logging feature (Settings -> Integrations). Must match the UDP port set there, or WSJT-X's packets never reach the container.

Config.Name: Failure Threshold
Config.Description: Consecutive failed polls before a hotspot is marked Offline

Config.Name: Max Workers
Config.Description: Parallel SSH checks per polling sweep

Config.Name: Active Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds of log silence before a node is forced back to idle. Set to 0 to disable.

Config.Name: QRZ Username
Config.Description: QRZ.com username, for looking up active caller name/city/state. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: QRZ Password
Config.Description: QRZ.com password (requires an active XML subscription to see other callsigns' info)
